[EN] Welcome, krrk!

I'll take care of those Blue Chips for you. Between you and me, don't even bother talking to the other merchants. You didn't hear it from me, but there are rumors going around about corruption and blackmail... krrk...
[ES] ¡Bienvenido, krrk!

Me encargaré de esas Blue Chips por ti. Entre tú y yo, ni te molestes en hablar con los otros mercaderes. No lo oíste de mí, pero corren rumores sobre corrupción y chantaje... krrk...
